title: Scanning a suffix of the input
statement: Let $y$ and $w_i$ be Boolean words, and let $i,k,p$ be natural numbers. If the suffix of $y$ obtained by dropping its first $i$ bits is $w_i$, $i\le |y|$, and $k\le |y|+1$, then there is a finite safe computation path from the scan-reading configuration with parameters $i,k,p$ to the configuration determined by the exit rule applied to the access check of $w_i$ and $k$, with parameters $0,k,p$.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ with its first i bits dropped equals $w_i$
